<script is:inline>
  // Shared filter tools: a search box, filters with removable pills, a count, and "Show more".
  (function () {
    function closeMenus(except) { document.querySelectorAll('details.fpop[open]').forEach(function (d) { if (!except || !d.contains(except)) d.removeAttribute('open'); }); }
    document.addEventListener('click', function (e) { closeMenus(e.target); });
    document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) { if (e.key === 'Escape') closeMenus(null); });
    var TLF = window.TLF = {};
    TLF.select = function (sel, attr) {
      return {
        test: function (it) { return !sel.value || it.dataset[attr] === sel.value; },
        pills: function () { return sel.value ? [{ label: sel.options[sel.selectedIndex].text, remove: function () { sel.value = ''; } }] : []; },
        clear: function () { sel.value = ''; }
      };
    };
    TLF.min = function (sel, attr, prefix) {
      return {
        test: function (it) { return !+sel.value || +it.dataset[attr] >= +sel.value; },
        pills: function () { return +sel.value ? [{ label: prefix + sel.options[sel.selectedIndex].text, remove: function () { sel.value = '0'; } }] : []; },
        clear: function () { sel.value = '0'; }
      };
    };
    TLF.chips = function (box, attr, all) {
      var cur = all;
      function paint() { [].forEach.call(box.children, function (c) { var on = c.dataset[attr] === cur; c.classList.toggle('on', on); c.setAttribute('aria-pressed', on ? 'true' : 'false'); }); }
      return {
        set: function (b) { cur = b.dataset[attr]; paint(); },
        test: function (it) { return cur === all || it.dataset[attr] === cur; },
        pills: function () { if (cur === all) return []; var b = [].filter.call(box.children, function (c) { return c.dataset[attr] === cur; })[0]; return [{ label: b ? b.textContent : cur, remove: function () { cur = all; paint(); } }]; },
        clear: function () { cur = all; paint(); }
      };
    };
    TLF.checks = function (wrap, match) {
      var menu = wrap.querySelector('.fpop-menu'), boxes = [].slice.call(menu.querySelectorAll('input[type=checkbox]')), text = wrap.querySelector('.ftext'), start = text.textContent;
      function picked() { return boxes.filter(function (b) { return b.checked; }); }
      function sync() { var p = picked(); text.textContent = !p.length ? start : p.length === 1 ? p[0].parentNode.textContent.trim() : p.length + ' selected'; }
      return {
        menu: menu, sync: sync,
        test: function (it) { return picked().every(function (b) { return match(it, b.value); }); },
        pills: function () { return picked().map(function (b) { return { label: b.parentNode.textContent.trim(), remove: function () { b.checked = false; sync(); } }; }); },
        clear: function () { boxes.forEach(function (b) { b.checked = false; }); sync(); }
      };
    };
    TLF.init = function (c) {
      var shown = c.step, bar = c.bar, toggle = bar.querySelector('.fbar-toggle');
      if (toggle) toggle.addEventListener('click', function () { var o = bar.classList.toggle('open'); toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', o ? 'true' : 'false'); });
      function run() {
        var words = c.search ? c.search.value.trim().toLowerCase().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean) : [], match = [];
        c.items.forEach(function (it) {
          var ok = words.every(function (w) { return it.dataset.name.indexOf(w) > -1; }) && c.filters.every(function (f) { return f.test(it); });
          it.classList.add('hidden'); if (ok) match.push(it);
        });
        match.slice(0, shown).forEach(function (it) { it.classList.remove('hidden'); });
        var n = match.length, k = Math.min(shown, n);
        c.count.textContent = !n ? '' : k < n ? 'Showing ' + k + ' of ' + n + ' ' + c.noun[1] : n + ' ' + (n === 1 ? c.noun[0] : c.noun[1]);
        c.empty.classList.toggle('hidden', n > 0); c.more.classList.toggle('hidden', n <= shown);
        var pills = []; c.filters.forEach(function (f) { pills = pills.concat(f.pills()); });
        c.pills.innerHTML = '';
        pills.forEach(function (p) {
          var b = document.createElement('button'), a = document.createElement('span'), x = document.createElement('span');
          b.type = 'button'; b.className = 'fpill'; b.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Remove filter: ' + p.label);
          a.textContent = p.label; x.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true'); x.textContent = '\u00d7'; b.appendChild(a); b.appendChild(x);
          b.addEventListener('click', function () { p.remove(); refresh(); }); c.pills.appendChild(b);
        });
        if (c.badge) { c.badge.textContent = pills.length; c.badge.classList.toggle('hidden', !pills.length); }
        c.clear.classList.toggle('hidden', !pills.length && !words.length);
      }
      function refresh() { shown = c.step; run(); }
      if (c.search) c.search.addEventListener('input', refresh);
      c.more.addEventListener('click', function () { shown += c.step; run(); });
      c.clear.addEventListener('click', function () { c.filters.forEach(function (f) { f.clear(); }); if (c.search) c.search.value = ''; refresh(); });
      run();
      return { refresh: refresh };
    };
  })();
</script>
